title: Understanding fusion energy
notes: Curator input for `npm run build-ladder -- --node engineering/energy-fusion --hints docs/research/fusion-ladder-curation.json`. Mirrors the fusion-candidates.md pattern: hand-authored, human-reviewed, versioned as data. role_hints/subtopic_keys pin the deterministic builder's episode-to-rung assignment (see backend/src/curation/ladderBuilder.ts); goals are the rung one-liners, copy-rule gated same as why-lines (<=18 words, no banned phrases).

goals.overview: The competing approaches to fusion power, and why none has reached the grid yet.
goals.fundamentals: Tokamak basics: what confinement means and why fusion plasma is so hard to hold.
goals.deep-dive-tokamak: Magnetic confinement in depth: the Lawson criterion, superconducting magnets, and today's tokamak startups.
goals.deep-dive-stellarator: The stellarator's harder-to-build, steadier-running alternative to the tokamak, from Wendelstein to planar coils.
goals.deep-dive-icf: How a 192-beam laser and a pinhead-sized target achieved fusion ignition at NIF.
goals.deep-dive-frc-zpinch: Two approaches that skip superconducting magnets entirely, confining plasma with its own current.
goals.frontier: Where the fusion race stands now: commercial timelines, plant economics, and who's closest.
